pages.text: Built as a column of the same block: the bottom one becomes the base, the middle ones masts, the top one the head with the rotor. It needs 1 to 6 masts.

There is no wind below Y 64. Above, the output grows up to $(b)100 FE/t$() at Y 128. Every block in the 5x5x3 space around the head takes a tenth off, so build it in the open. Rain adds a fifth, thunder a half.
pages.title: Output

pages.text: Only the base gives energy; connect the cable to it. Right clicking any part shows the output and what is in the way.
